headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: On Main Street, Goldman Sachs makes a bet on AI
headlines.description: Goldman Sachs partners with OpenAI, Google, Meta and Anthropic to boost AI adoption among small businesses.

headlines.title: Money Conversations at Every Age: What to Discuss by Generation
headlines.description: From teens to aging parents, certified financial planner Ted Jenkin joins TODAY with the conversations every family should have at every age. He discusses teaching teens to read a paystub, helping adult children in their 20s and 30s build up their own credit, the documents aging parents should have in place and more.

headlines.title: iPhone Duo review: Is Apple's first foldable smartphone too expensive?
headlines.description: Apple will release the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, this Friday. NBC News' chief technology analyst Joanna Stern reviews the new iPhone and its hefty price tag.

headlines.title: Fall Job Search Strategies to Add Some Extra Cash to Your Wallet
headlines.description: With the holidays approaching, some companies are looking to fill roles now and there are plenty of roles for part timers who just want a little extra money. NBC’s Vicky Ngyen joins TODAY to share why fall is the time to strike on a new career opportunity, tips to standout with recruiters, and more.

headlines.title: Zero-Dollar Splurge: How Fake Stores Deliver Real Retail Therapy
headlines.description: Fake websites, that started as a joke in South Korea, simulate online retailers to offer the satisfaction of buying without actually paying. Now, they're gaining real traction. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen reports for TODAY on why users say the “dopamine sites” are saving them big bucks while scratching that shopping itch.

headlines.title: How grocery prices have changed since Trump took office
headlines.description: Learn where grocery prices stand during the Trump administration. See how inflation is affecting the cost of eggs, bread, chicken, ground beef and more.

headlines.title: Netflix doesn’t want investors to worry, despite recent shake-ups, layoffs
headlines.description: “Reminder, we are a streaming-first business. That is our core,” co-CEO Ted Sarandos said on the streamer’s third-quarter earnings call.

headlines.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to discuss merger idea
headlines.description: Musk said he isn’t a member of either special committee or involved in the talks because he’s a conflicted party under securities regulations.

headlines.title: Spotify says it removed 50 million ‘slop’ and spam AI tracks this year
headlines.description: The company found that songs users frequently skipped or ignored consistently overlapped with artificially generated audio.

headlines.title: Oil prices whipsaw as markets weigh Middle East turmoil against uncertain demand
headlines.description: After hitting recent highs mid-morning, crude oil prices tumbled in the wake of weaker than expected housing data.

headlines.title: CNN’s Christiane Amanpour to leave network after 43 years
headlines.description: “I’m very sorry to see her go, but I’ve come to accept that this is the right time for her, both personally and professionally,” CNN chief executive Mark Thompson said.
